train_sentencepiece_tokenizer: train a sentencepiece tokenizer on a corpus with specified vocab size and model type
encode_text_as_ids: encode text into token ids using a sentencepiece or wordpiece tokenizer
decode_ids_to_text: decode a list of token ids back into readable text string
create_bert_wordpiece_tokenizer: create a bert wordpiece tokenizer from pretrained model for BERT training
tokenize_with_gpt2_bpe: tokenize text using GPT2 BPE tokenizer and encode as ids or tokens
